title: Run.WorktreeMade
description: The payload of a worktree run's second event (topic troupe.core.runs.aggregate:Run.WorktreeMade): its worktree, named by the run's start, is made and filled, and the runner hasn't started yet. Recorded by the person's command, which made it. Absent from a run: its worktree wasn't made.

clones.description: The clone mechanisms used for the files that matched HEAD, sorted. Empty: every file was checked out.
